brief: Goldman's 7 Oct US Daily Download opens with the S&P 500 at a fresh all-time high ($7,844, the year's 28th record) on an NDX breakout GS ties to clean investor positioning (GS Prime Brokerage HF net exposure near a 5-year low, GS Sentiment indicator near multi-year lows), covering of macro hedges, and continued dollar concentration into Tech/AI even as market breadth falls to its lowest level since 2000. On data, GS lowered its Q3 GDP tracking estimate by 0.3pp to +3.1% q/q annualized after August's trade deficit widened by $12.7bn to $105.6bn, worse than GS's prior assumptions. On single names: GS stayed Neutral on Marvell after its Investor Day, expecting the stock to hold its post-event 6% gain on above-Street FY31 targets (revenue CAGR 55%-60%, EPS ~$30) but wants stronger evidence of design-win execution before turning more constructive. GS also reiterated its Buy on Costco with a $1,134 price target after a Texas club tour reinforced its view that Costco keeps gaining value share into FY27. Session color also flagged HDD weakness (STX, WDC), a biotech selloff led by AVBP, and a Power Up America/AI power-demand bid in GOOGL and CEG.
